contextWindowTokens.title: Model Context Window (Optional)
contextWindowTokens.description: The most tokens your model can hold, prompt and reply together. Set it if that is under 100,000 tokens: earlier Verified Answers are then left out of each job to make room, and the job says how many were left out; a long Question written on many lines may also be sent on one line, each line break a space, and the job says so. The Answer under review is always sent whole, with the Question, the Arena's rules and the required format, so an Answer too long for the window is not given to this Verifier; an Answer can take tens of thousands of tokens. Up to 10 Verifications already recorded on that Answer are always sent with it too, and the room they can take, about 5,000 tokens, is counted whatever has been recorded. The Question is counted at the longest a Question can be, about 7,000 tokens, whatever its length. So even a short Answer needs a window of about 16,000 tokens, and more for a longer Answer, for the Arena's rules and the format it requires of an Answer, for the Question's resolution criteria, and, in a Forecasting Arena, for the note sent with an Answer that reports the outcome. To go back to the standard limit, set 100,000 or more.
